chunks: And from him, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from one who informed him, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
I asked him: Is the Surah divided in two rak'ahs? He said: 'Yes, divide it as you wish.'
ai.seo_question: Can I split one Surah between two rak'ahs in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the flexibility of *Qira'ah* (recitation) in obligatory prayers, specifically addressing the permissibility of splitting a single Surah between the two rak'ahs of Fajr or other two-rak'ah prayers. By stating 'split it as you wish,' the Imam (peace be upon him) indicates that while reciting a complete Surah in each rak'ah is preferred, dividing one Surah is fully valid and does not invalidate the prayer, reflecting the practical ease granted to worshippers in Shia jurisprudence.
